name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia Ramirez's journey into the heart of motorsport began not on the track, but amidst the intricate workings of her father's auto repair shop in Mexico City. From a young age, she was captivated by the mechanics of engines and the precision required to coax the best performance out of machinery. This early exposure fueled her passion, leading her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering with a specialization in automotive technology.

After graduating, Sofia quickly immersed herself in the racing world, starting as a junior engineer with a smaller racing team before landing a role at Peugeot TotalEnergies. Her meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage complex projects efficiently earned her a swift promotion to Head of Operations. Sofia excels at streamlining processes, optimizing resource allocation, and ensuring that the team functions cohesively under pressure. She's known for her calm demeanor and her ability to make critical decisions quickly and effectively. Sofia is focused on creating a supportive work environment that fosters innovation and continuous improvement, which she believes is key to sustained success in the competitive world of motorsport.

Sofia's hands-on experience with vehicle mechanics, coupled with her strong leadership abilities, makes her a unique asset to Peugeot TotalEnergies. She’s not afraid to get her hands dirty and work alongside her team, and she's committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail or bun.
physical.description: Sofia has a warm smile and a focused gaze, reflecting her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool on her keychain.
Prefers to communicate via meticulously organized spreadsheets.
Has a habit of sketching mechanical diagrams during team meetings.
